NEW DELHI: Leader of opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi on Sunday took a swipe at BJP, thanking the ruling party and its allies for promoting the INDIA bloc's November 1 rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan, as he urged people to join the protest over alleged “vote chori”. This comes a day after BJP asked the Congress leader to defer the rally date from November 1 as it conincided with 1981 anti-Sikh riots anniversary.In a post on X, Rahul called for a “Save the Vote, Save the Country” march and mega rally, alleging that voter names had been deleted from electoral rolls and rules and laws violated."Our votes are being stolen, and we will not tolerate this quietly under any circumstances. Names have been removed from the voter lists. Rules and laws have been broken. And lathis have been used on those asking questions. Now the country will respond," he said.He urged students, farmers, workers, women, youth and traders to attend the rally, saying, “The vote is yours. The fight is also yours.”"Students, farmers, laborers, women, youth, and traders - anyone who cares about democracy must come. The vote is yours.The fight is also yours," he said.Also Read: 'Ignore strike calls': LPG distributor body ahead of Rahul Gandhi's rally in Delhi Taking a dig at the BJP and its allies, Rahul wrote: “Heartfelt thanks to BJP and its allies, who are promoting this program with such great enthusiasm and reaching it to more and more people.” He urged them to maintain the same enthusiasm over the next seven days."Just keep up this same zeal and dedication for the next 7 days!" he said.The BJP has objected to the November 1 date, alleging that holding the rally on the anniversary of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots would hurt Sikh sentiments. BJP spokesperson Ravi Shankar Prasad accused Congress of being insensitive to the community and traders.The rally has drawn criticism from Delhi's Chamber of Trade and Industry (CTI), which has urged Rahul to postpone it until after November 10, citing potential disruption to festive-season business. The traders' body said the rally could affect trade worth Rs 10,000 crore. Moreover, the Federation of LPG Distributors of India (FLDI) has also opposed the rally.Separately, INDIA bloc leaders are scheduled to hold a “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on October 30, with a mock Parliament planned at Delhi's Hotel Ashok.The opposition's campaign centres on allegations of “vote chori” and irregularities in the special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
Article Summary: Rahul Gandhi thanked the BJP for promoting the INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally at Ramlila Maidan. This comes a day after BJP asked the Congress leader to defer the rally date from November 1. The BJP has objected to the November 1 date, alleging that holding the rally on the anniversary of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots would hurt Sikh sentiments.

Article Title: Bihar MLC polls: 5.32 lakh voters to decide fate of 150 candidates across 8 seats, JD(U) rift adds intrigue
Article Text:
Polling began at 8 am today for eight seats in the Bihar Legislative Council (Representative image)





PATNA: Polling for biennial elections to eight Bihar Legislative Council seats began at 8 am on Friday amid tight security, with 5.32 lakh voters eligible to decide the fate of 150 candidates, officials said.Voting will continue till 4 pm for four Graduates and four Teachers constituencies, they said.The combined electorate stands at 5,32,847, including 1,46,611 women and 37 third-gender voters, across 933 polling stations. Counting of votes will take place on October 27.The contest in the Patna Graduates constituency has drawn attention following an open rift within the JD(U), with Mokama MLA Anant Singh backing Jan Suraaj Party candidate Anuj Singh against his own party's nominee, Neeraj Kumar.Kumar, a former minister and a close aide of former chief minister Nitish Kumar, is seeking a fourth consecutive term from the seat.Anant Singh has extended support to Anuj Singh, alleging that Neeraj Kumar had worked against him during last year's assembly elections.Apart from Patna Graduates, the other constituencies going to polls are Darbhanga Graduates, Tirhut Graduates, Kosi Graduates, Patna Teachers, Darbhanga Teachers, Tirhut Teachers and Saran Teachers.The terms of the sitting MLCs are due to expire on November 16.The BJP has fielded candidates in four constituencies, including three sitting MLCs seeking re-election, while the JD(U) has nominated candidates for the remaining four seats.The BJP nominees are MLCs Nawal Kishor Yadav, NK Yadav and Sarvesh Kumar, who are seeking re-election from Patna Teachers, Kosi Graduates and Tirhut Graduates, respectively.The party has also fielded Narendra Kumar Singh from Tirhut Teachers, a seat currently held by Sanjay Kumar Singh of the CPI, a constituent of the opposition INDIA bloc.The Jan Suraaj Party (JSP), led by Prashant Kishor, is contesting all eight seats. The party revised its candidate list after its initial announcement, replacing Bhushan Jha with Shyam Nandan Yadav in Tirhut Teachers and Ravindra Yadav with Mohammad Imtiyaz (Noorani) in Darbhanga Graduates.(With PTI inputs)
Article Summary: Voting will continue till 4 pm for four Graduates and four Teachers constituencies. The combined electorate stands at 5,32,847, including 1,46,611 women and 37 third-gender voters. Counting of votes will take place on October 27.

Article Title: Amit Shah visits Delhi police headquarters amid law and order concerns
Article Text:
Amit Shah visits Delhi police HQ amid law and order scrutiny

NEW DELHI: Union home minister Amit Shah visited the Delhi Police headquarters on Jai Singh Road on Saturday to meet senior police officials and discuss the law and order situation in the national capital.Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta also arrived at the headquarters.Shah reached the headquarters around 3 pm, where senior officers were expected to brief him on the force's performance, ongoing investigations and key law enforcement challenges, officials said.The visit comes amid heightened scrutiny of the Delhi Police over allegations of excessive force against protesters during the Cockroach Janata Party's (CJP) 'Sansad Chalo' march in July.The visit marks Shah's return to the Delhi Police headquarters after more than four years. He last visited the facility on August 30, 2022.The meeting comes as the Congress and other INDIA bloc parties prepare for a rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar amid ongoing protests against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.Congress MP Jebi Mather said the rally was a joint decision taken after consultations with INDIA bloc parties and maintained that there were no differences within the opposition over the demand for the CEC's resignation.“The November 1st rally is by the Congress party with the INDIA bloc, and it is decided after consultations with the INDIA bloc, and it’s a joint decision, and there’s nothing particular about the date, but we have a series of protests. We have had a series of protests. We have different mechanisms and systems we put in place for our demand that Gyanesh Kumar must resign,” she said.Describing the proposed gathering as a nationwide mobilisation, Mather said political parties from across the country would join the rally to press for Kumar's resignation.“This is a mega rally from across the country; different parties, everybody is going to come together and have a strong demand that Gyanesh Kumar must resign. So there are no differences within the INDIA bloc or opposition parties about this,” she said.Mather added that the rally would send a united message on protecting democracy and restoring fairness in the electoral system.Senior Congress MP KC Venugopal said the rally was intended to demonstrate opposition unity amid the agitation against the CEC.“Our programs against the criminal Vote Chori orchestrated by Gyanesh & Co. - at Modi-Shah's behest - will be historic. People from all across the country will be attending in massive numbers, and it will send a strong message to every corner of India that we are united in protecting our democracy and driving these Vote Chors out of power,” he said.Venugopal had announced the November 1 rally on October 5 as part of the ongoing agitation against the SIR and CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
Article Summary: Union home minister Amit Shah visited the Delhi Police headquarters on Jai Singh Road on Saturday. He met senior police officials and discussed the law and order situation in the national capital. Visit comes amid heightened scrutiny of Delhi Police over allegations of excessive force against protesters during Cockroach Janata Party's 'Sansad Chalo' march in July.

Article Title: EC declares UP MLC poll at three Agra stations 'void', orders repoll on October 26
Article Text:
EC declares UP MLC poll at three Agra stations 'void'

NEW DELHI: The Election Commission on Saturday declared the poll taken on Friday at three polling stations of Agra division's teachers constituency for UP legislative council election, as "void" and ordered a fresh repoll there on Oct 26. This follows allegations of poll irregularities and harassment by the Samajwadi Party candidate and supporters.A communication sent by EC to the Uttar Pradesh chief electoral officer on Saturday asked the Agra divisional commissioner to fix responsibility of the persons involved, including police and polling officers, that led to the incidents resulting in re-poll at the aforesaid polling stations. "This enquiry shall be done immediately and the report...sent to the Commission latest by 25.10.2026," stated the poll panel.The Commission declared as null and void the poll taken, in exercise of powers conferred on it under Section 58A (2)(a) of the Representation of the People Act, 1951. "It must be ensured that the persons involved in any unlawful activities which may have caused the irregularities/lapses leading to vitiation of poll are not deputed during the said re-poll," the EC conveyed to the UP CEO.The commission further directed that indelible ink shall be applied on the right hand forefinger of the electors.A fresh permission for commencement of counting of votes in respect of Agra division Teachers' constituency shall be obtained after the successful completion of repoll in the aforementioned polling stations in the proforma prescribed by the Commission, the EC ordered.Dramatic scenes had unfolded after the poll in Agra as Samajwadi Party MLC candidate Akash Agarwal broke down before the media, alleging booth capturing, electoral irregularities and harassment of his supporters during polling.Agarwal accused the BJP and local administration of interfering with the polling process in Kheragarh, Fatehabad and other areas. He alleged that his supporters and school management associates across 12 districts were being harassed, with repeated complaints failing to bring any relief.
Article Summary: The Election Commission on Saturday declared the poll taken on Friday at three polling stations of Agra division's teachers constituency for UP legislative council election, as "void" and ordered a fresh repoll there on Oct 26. This follows allegations of poll irregularities and harassment by the Samajwadi Party candidate.

Article Title: Congress to launch door-to-door campaign, hold marches over voter list 'discrepancies'
Article Text:
Congress alleged that crores of voters across the country had been unfairly deprived of their voting rights due to large-scale deletions and discrepancies in electoral rolls.

Congress to appoint booth-level agents

Solanki flags discrepancies in Latur

NEW DELHI: The Congress will hold marches, conduct door-to-door visits and organise awareness meetings to address alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. The party will also ensure all eligible citizens are registered by the end of December, senior party leader and former Union minister Bharatsinh Solanki said on Saturday.Congress plans to appoint booth-level agents to verify voter lists and flag discrepancies to election authorities.Addressing a press conference, Solanki, an All India Congress Committee (AICC) observer, said the campaign would cover rural and remote areas as well as urban centres. It aims to put a special focus on disadvantaged communities and young voters. The party will distribute pamphlets and hold meetings to raise awareness about the issue, he added.Solanki alleged that crores of voters across the country had been unfairly deprived of their voting rights due to large-scale deletions and discrepancies in electoral rolls. He accused the Centre and the Election Commission of allowing electoral procedures to be misused."The country's democracy and Constitution are under threat amid rising inflation, unemployment and corruption. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge and leader of opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi have launched a nationwide campaign to raise awareness about electoral malpractices," he said.As part of the campaign, the Congress will appoint a booth level agent-2 (BLA-2) at every polling booth to work alongside booth level officers (BLOs) and verify electoral rolls through door-to-door visits, Solanki said.The party will submit complaints to the relevant authorities over discrepancies and, if necessary, approach district election officials, the state election machinery and the Supreme Court, he added.Referring to the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, Solanki said the exercise had previously been undertaken in 12 states and was currently underway in 17 states. He alleged that the ECI, despite being an independent constitutional body, was facing pressure from those in power.Citing Latur city constituency, he said around 45,000 voter entries had been identified as suspicious or potentially affected by discrepancies. These included more than 12,000 entries relating to deceased voters, over 6,000 suspected duplicate entries, and names of people who were absent, had migrated or were listed at incorrect addresses, he said.
Article Summary: Congress will hold marches, conduct door-to-door visits and organise awareness meetings to address alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. The party will also ensure all eligible citizens are registered by the end of December, senior party leader and former Union minister Bharatsinh Solanki said. Congress plans to appoint booth-level agents to verify voter lists and flag discrepancies to election authorities.

NEW DELHI: The BJP on Saturday asked the Congress to clarify whether it supported demands for Kashmir’s separation from India and the release of Sharjeel Imam , an accused in the 2020 Delhi riots case.This came a day after Congress MP Imran Masood visited Delhi’s Jamia Millia Islamia University to express solidarity with students protesting for the restoration of the students’ union.Graffiti bearing slogans such as “Fresh Kashmir” and “Free Sharjeel Imam” appeared on the university’s walls amid the ongoing agitation."Does the Congress party endorse the demand, boldly written at Jamia Millia Islamia, to separate Kashmir from India? What is the Congress party's stand on Sharjeel Imam?" BJP MP Ravi Shankar Prasad said at a press conference at the party headquarters in the capital.Prasad also questioned why Masood visited the Jamia university, calling it a “serious issue”.“What was he (Masood) doing there? We condemn it. His visit raises serious questions because he is not just a Congress MP but also the working president of the party's Uttar Pradesh unit,” the former Union minister added.Prasad further stated that Jammu and Kashmir had been progressing since Article 370, which gave special status to the erstwhile state, was revoked in August 2019.“The transformation that has taken place across Kashmir is being praised globally. We strongly condemn any conspiracy to incite unrest on the issue of Kashmir, and we advocate for strict action (against any such move). Kashmir is an integral part of India and would remain so forever,” the BJP leader remarked.The agitation at Jamia Millia Islamia University began on October 12, with protesters demanding an official notification announcing a schedule for the students' union elections. The last elections were held in 2005, and the union was dissolved in 2006.Sharjeel Imam, currently in judicial custody, was arrested on August 25, 2020, and booked under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) allegedly for being one of the "masterminds" of the February 2020 riots in northeast Delhi that left 53 people dead and over 700 injured.

Article Title: Jarange audio row: BJP claims Sanjay Raut made fake 'Rs 500 cr' audio clip; MP defends authenticity
Article Text:
BJP alleges audio clip was scripted at Saamana office

Raut blames BJP's internal rivalry for leak

Jarange alleges conspiracy to weaken Maratha agitation

What happened

The Bharatiya Janata Party on Saturday claimed that Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut, at the behest of Rahul Gandhi, orchestrated a fake audio clip, purportedly revealing that BJP functionaries offered Rs 500 crore to Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange.BJP spokesperson Navnath Ban alleged that the clip was generated using artificial intelligence to advance Rahul Gandhi's agenda and create a rift among ruling alliance partners. He demanded that a case be registered against Raut, if necessary, and that a probe be conducted into whether he received funding from Rahul Gandhi for the alleged conspiracy."Sanjay Raut orchestrated the conspiracy from a war room in Navi Mumbai's Vashi. The contract to defame the BJP has been taken by Raut from Rahul Gandhi. Raut has been consistently pushing Gandhi's agenda over the past few days," Ban said.He alleged that Raut had been working on the audio clip for nearly two months, using AI to combine voice samples available on YouTube."Raut scripted the purported conversations at the (Sena UBT mouthpiece) Saamana's office and initially considered an allegation involving Rs 100 crore before raising the amount to Rs 500 crore to attract greater media attention," he added.Ban claimed the clip was intended to tarnish the reputations of BJP leaders, Maharashtra deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde and Jarange, and trigger a conflict between them.BJP MLC Prasad Lad also demanded that Raut be named the main accused and "conspirator"."An offence should be registered, and Sanjay Raut should be the first person to be picked up for questioning. He should be questioned about how he knew how the clip was made, who made it and what went into its creation," Lad told reporters.Lad also alleged that the clip was created at the Saamana press."Sanjay Raut was the writer of the audio clip and conceptualised what each person should say and how they should say it. The voice-overs were generated through AI," he alleged.Raut, meanwhile, claimed that the leak was a result of fierce internal competition within the BJP. He said Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis should first register a case and then order a forensic examination of the audio clip, though he claimed the probe would yield no results."The clip was leaked by a BJP MLC. He was involved in the talks with Jarange. The CM treated him with a lot of affection, which has backfired," Raut said without naming the lawmaker."If an internal audio clip is getting leaked, then the Home Department has gone against you (the CM)," he said, adding that the BJP was the victim of a sting operation.Raut further claimed that the "cold war" between Fadnavis and his deputy Shinde had reached its peak, alleging that the two could go to any length to politically eliminate each other.Jarange also released the audio clip, alleging that a conspiracy had been hatched to silence him and weaken the Maratha reservation movement.Speaking to the media in Jalna, Jarange claimed he was being targeted because he had been raising issues concerning farmers and ordinary citizens."We have revealed the things (hidden) behind the curtain. In fact, we have torn the curtain. Leaders of all political parties have woken up because of this, which is important for me. I will be going to the root of this case," he said.Jarange urged Fadnavis and Shinde to get to the bottom of the matter and ensure that no one involved was spared.He alleged that "party funds" had been used to defame him and the Maratha quota agitation, without specifying the party."Shinde should look into this and should not spare those involved, even if they are part of his group. If he does not act, we will believe that no caste or community should expect justice from the government," Jarange said.On Thursday, Jarange released around 10 minutes of a 32-minute audio clip alleging that Rs 500 crore had been paid to him to call off his agitation. He claimed the recording exposed a conspiracy to weaken the reservation movement.In the viral recording, which purportedly features BJP functionaries, a woman is heard claiming that Rs 500 crore had been delivered to Jarange through Shrikant Shinde, son of Eknath Shinde and a Shiv Sena MP.The speakers are also heard discussing strategies to counter Jarange's growing political influence in the Marathwada region ahead of the 2024 assembly elections.On Friday, Fadnavis ordered a forensic examination of the audio clip amid allegations by Shiv Sena leader Ramdas Kadam that BJP insiders were colluding with Jarange to "finish off" Shinde politically.
Article Summary: BJP alleges audio clip was scripted at Saamana office. Raut blames BJP's internal rivalry for leak. Jarange alleges conspiracy to weaken Maratha agitation. The clip purportedly reveals that BJP functionaries offered Rs 500 crore to Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange.

NEW DELHI: Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami on Saturday hit back at Samajwadi Party (SP) president Akhilesh Yadav over his “ghuspaithiya” (infiltrator) remark targeting a person from the hill state.In a video shared by news agency IANS, the former Uttar Pradesh chief minister is seen saying, “Who is the biggest infiltrator in Uttar Pradesh? He is from Uttarakhand.”The remarks appeared to be directed at Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath, who was born in Pauri Garhwal district when it was part of undivided Uttar Pradesh. The region is now in Uttarakhand, which was carved out of Uttar Pradesh in 2000.In response, Dhami accused Akhilesh Yadav of “insulting” the people of Uttarakhand. He also invoked the 1994 Rampur Tiraha firing incident, in which Uttar Pradesh Police opened fire on activists campaigning for a separate Uttarakhand state.Akhilesh Yadav’s father, Mulayam Singh Yadav, was the Uttar Pradesh chief minister at the time."Uttarakhand is both the Devbhoomi (land of Gods) and Veerbhoomi (land of the brave). This sacred soil has given the nation numerous saints, soldiers, and individuals devoted to national service. Shri Akhilesh Yadav ji, calling the people of Uttarakhand infiltrators, is an insult to the pride of the Devbhoomi and to our struggles," Dhami posted on X."The people of Uttarakhand also have not forgotten that when Akhilesh Yadav ji's father, Mulayam Singh Yadav, was the chief minister of Uttar Pradesh, bullets were fired at the agitators demanding a separate Uttarakhand state at Rampur Tiraha in Muzaffarnagar. Bullets were fired at Uttarakhand's agitators during the father's regime, and today the son is calling the people of Uttarakhand infiltrators! The people of Uttarakhand can never forget their struggles and sacrifices," he added.Dhami also questioned whether the Congress, the Samajwadi Party’s ally in Uttar Pradesh, supported Akhilesh Yadav’s remarks.“Does the Congress support this statement from its political ally, Shri Akhilesh Yadav ji? Is calling the people of Uttarakhand infiltrators acceptable to the Congress? The Congress must answer the people of this Devbhoomi,” he said.Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, both with BJP governments, are scheduled to hold assembly elections early next year. The party has been in power in both states since 2017.
Article Summary: Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami hit back at Samajwadi Party (SP) president Akhilesh Yadav over his "ghuspaithiya" (infiltrator) remark. In a video shared by news agency IANS, the former Uttar Pradesh chief minister is seen saying, “Who is the biggest infiltrator in Uttar Pradesh? He is from Uttarakhand”

Team of lawyer comrades are in touch with them.But if any lawyer can be at the PS immediately, pls DM."Rosie is among the three female journalists who filed complaint alleging sexual harassment by police personnel during a protest in the New Delhi area on October 3.The complants have been transferred to the Crime Branch at Kamla Market for further action.Delhi Police also detained several protesters outside Parliament Street Police Station who were demonstrating over an alleged incident of sexual misconduct involving three women journalists during an October 3 protest at Jantar Mantar.The protesters alleged that they had been demonstrating since 6pm on Sunday, demanding registration of an FIR in the case. Police detained them around 7am on Monday following a clash, with protesters alleging they were treated poorly despite only seeking registration of an FIR. Trinamool Congress (TMC) MP Derek O’Brien also extended support to Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders as party spokesperson Ashutosh Ranka claimed that multiple sources had warned that the three could be arrested before October 10 under the National Security Act (NSA) or other equivalent provisions.“With you all the way 🪳🪳stay strong. ‘10 Oct poora desh aa raha hai…’,” O’Brien said in a post on X while replying to Dipke.CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke reacting to the claim said they would not be intimidated by the possibility of action under laws such as the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) or National Security Act (NSA).“If the Govt believes that the threat of UAPA, NSA or years behind bars will scare us into silence, it won’t,” Dipke said in a post on X, adding that the protesters were prepared to spend “months or years in jail” but would not back down from their campaign to “save democracy”.He further said that they follow the path shown by Mahatma Gandhi and continue to resist “peacefully and non-violently”, despite what he described as attempts by the state to intimidate them.The developments come amid the CJP-led campaign against the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The protesters have been demanding accountability from chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the exercise and have announced further mobilisation on October 10 in Delhi.
Article Summary: AISA national president Neha Bora claims that protesting journalists have been detained at the Delhi Cantonment Police Station. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke reacting to the claim said they would not be intimidated by the possibility of action under laws such as the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act.

Article Title: Karnataka's CM DK Shivakumar OKs IAS officer's prosecution in KPSC exam paper leak case
Article Text:
Karnataka's Chief Minister D K Shivakumar has approved the prosecution of IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar.

The investigation is being conducted by the CID's Special Investigation Team and the Enforcement Directorate.





BENGALURU: Chief minister D K Shivakumar Saturday sanctioned the prosecution of suspended senior IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar in connection with alleged question paper leak in Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC) exam for recruitment of veterinary officers.The prosecution sanction could enable further legal action against Gangwar, who had served as the KPSC controller of examinations from Jan 2024 to March 2026. He has been accused of passing on the exam question paper to prime accused Basavaraj Kannale by misusing his official position.Announcing the govt's decision on X, Shivakumar posted: "No room for corruption, no protection for the guilty. Permission has been granted to prosecute IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar in a corruption case related to the KPSC recruitment scam. Our govt will not tolerate any action that toys with the future of the youth."The CID's Special Investigation Team (SIT) and the Enforcement Directorate (ED) are probing the case.
Article Summary: Karnataka's Chief Minister D K Shivakumar has approved the prosecution of IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar. He has been accused of passing on the exam question paper to prime accused Basavaraj Kannale by misusing his official position.

Article Title: Court acquits rape accused in UP, puts woman’s father in dock
Article Text:
A special court in Ambedkar Nagar has delivered a verdict of not guilty for Ramakant Verma, who faced allegations of abduction and rape





LUCKNOW: A special court in Ambedkar Nagar has acquitted a man accused of abducting and raping a woman, citing lack of evidence against him..Ramakant Verma alias Monu Verma was accused of abducting a young woman in Ambedkar Nagar and taking her to Mumbai where he raped her.Special Judge (SC/ST Act) Chintaram noted that the alleged survivor and her parents had retracted their earlier statements and did not support the allegations made in the complaint.The court also ordered the registration of separate proceedings against the complainant, Radheyshyam, for giving false evidence. It directed that the money provided by govt in connection with the case be deposited with the social welfare department within one month. The matter against the complainant has been scheduled for hearing on Nov 22.According to the prosecution, Radheyshyam had submitted a complaint at the Jahangirganj police station on July 17, 2019, stating that his daughter, 20, had left home to relieve herself on May 18, 2019, but did not return.After searching for her, the family lodged a missing-person report.He claimed that his daughter returned home crying on the evening of July 8 and told the family that Ramakant along with two unidentified men, had forcibly taken her to Mumbai.She was allegedly assaulted and abused there. The complaint further alleged that the accused threatened to kill her if she reported the matter when she was dropped near the Jahangirganj intersection.Police had registered an FIR under relevant provisions relating to kidnapping, assault, verbal abuse, criminal intimidation and the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act. After completing the investigation, police filed a chargesheet against the accused, including charges of rape and other offences. The court framed charges in Jan 2020.During the trial, the woman told the court that someone had grabbed her from behind while she was returning from a field late at night, but she could not identify the person.She further stated that the FIR had been lodged under pressure from villagers and that she had given statements to the police under pressure.Radheyshyam told the court that his daughter had gone to her maternal grandparents’ home after becoming upset over being scolded. Her mother corroborated his statement.
Article Summary: Ramakant Verma was accused of abducting a young woman in Ambedkar Nagar and taking her to Mumbai where he raped her. Special Judge Chintaram noted that the alleged survivor and her parents had retracted their earlier statements and did not support the allegations made in the complaint.

Article Title: FIR filed after students allege ‘inappropriate touch’ by teacher in Rajasthan
Article Text:
A government school teacher in Khairthal-Tijara district has been placed under awaiting posting order status (Representative image)





JAIPUR: A govt school teacher serving as acting principal of a school in Khairthal-Tijara district has been placed under awaiting posting order (APO) status after several girl students of Classes 5 and 6 accused him of inappropriate touch, prompting an FIR Saturday on a complaint by their parents.The teacher, Gajraj Singh Yadav, was posted at Govt Middle School in Meoli village of Kotkasim tehsil.“An FIR was registered against the teacher following a complaint by the parents, who alleged that he had inappropriately touched some minor girls eight to 10 days ago,” said Kotkasim SHO Jaswant Yadav.Kotkasim chief block education officer Om Prakash Verma said the matter first surfaced on Oct 17, when one girl complained to a female teacher.“When the teacher spoke to other students, they too reported a similar pattern of behaviour. We visited the school Friday after being informed of the matter and found concerned local villagers gathered there,” Verma told TOI.“We tried contacting the teacher in question, but he did not answer our calls,” he added.Khairthal-Tijara district education officer Ramesh Kumar Megh said a departmental inquiry has been initiated against Yadav.
Article Summary: The teacher, Gajraj Singh Yadav, was posted at Govt Middle School in Meoli village of Kotkasim tehsil. The matter first surfaced on Oct 17, when one girl complained to a female teacher. A departmental inquiry has been initiated against Yadav.

Article Title: CJP’s Saurav Das mocks claims over his Delhi residence: ‘Right-wing people will declare I’m from Neptune’
Article Text:
CJP leader Saurav Das recently took to social media to mock the allegations surrounding his residence in Delhi

Saurav Das's tweet





NEW DELHI: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leader Saurav Das took a sarcastic swipe at his critics on social media after claims surfaced that he had failed to establish his Delhi residence before a Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) court in a peace bond violation case.A social media post alleged that the magistrate found no rent agreement, lease document or other evidence establishing Saurav Das’s residence in Delhi.It further claimed that Das had been directed to submit proof of his Delhi address in connection with the case. Das responded to the claims in a post on X, saying, “Soon these right-wing andhbhakts will declare I’m an extra-terrestrial being sent from Neptune!”Saurav Das’s Delhi address under scrutiny amid peace bond proceedingsThe address-related claims have emerged amid proceedings involving CJP leaders Das and Ashutosh Ranka. The two were released after the SEM court accepted their personal and surety bonds and recorded their written undertakings to maintain peace and abide by the law.The court had directed them to furnish personal and surety bonds of Rs 50,000 each until the conclusion of the enquiry.They were also required to appear on hearing dates and comply with the conditions specified in their bonds and undertakings.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: Saurav Das took to social media to mock the allegations surrounding his residence in Delhi. A social media post alleged that the magistrate found no rent agreement, lease document or other evidence establishing Saurav Das’s residence. Das responded to the claims in a post on X, saying, “Soon these right-wing andhbhakts will declare I’m an extra-terrestrial being sent from Neptune!"

Article Title: ‘Do you eat beef’: Coimbatore teacher under scanner after Dalit Class XI student dies by suicide
Article Text:
Peelamedu police have registered a case involving a teacher, headmaster, and two students related to a student’s suicide





COIMBATORE: Peelamedu police in the city have registered a case under three sections against four people, including two students of a government-aided school, in connection with the suicide of a Scheduled Caste student near Peelamedu.A. Akilan, 16, was a Class XI student of a government-aided school (KK Naidu) near Peelamedu. On Wednesday, his parents went to work while Akilan stayed at their home near Peelamedu.Upon returning from work, his mother, Kowsalya, found him hanging from the ceiling in a bedroom.She lodged a complaint with the Peelamedu police on Wednesday stating that Akilan had informed her that other students in the school were not talking to him after learning that he belonged to a Scheduled Caste.Furthermore, she alleged that the teacher had questioned the student about whether he ate beef, and the headmaster was accused of failing to take action regarding the incident.Peelamedu police have registered a case against the teacher, headmaster, and two fellow students in connection with Akilan's suicide, and further investigation is underway.
Article Summary: A. Akilan, 16, was a Class XI student of a government-aided school near Peelamedu. His mother, Kowsalya, found him hanging from the ceiling in a bedroom. Police have registered a case against the teacher, headmaster, and two fellow students.

Article Title: 29-year-old Hyderabad techie found hanging in apartment
Article Text:
A 29-year-old software employee, was discovered dead by hanging in Hyderabad (Representative image generated using AI)





HYDERABAD: A 29-year-old software employee was found dead by hanging in an apartment in Chandra Nayak Thanda under the Madhapur police station limits in Hyderabad.The deceased has been identified as Archana Chowdhury Malik, a native of Uttar Pradesh who worked as a software employee at Mindspace.According to Madhapur Police, personnel reached the spot after receiving information about the incident.The police registered a case and are investigating the circumstances surrounding her death.(With agency inputs)
Article Summary: The deceased has been identified as Archana Chowdhury Malik, a native of Uttar Pradesh. She worked as a software employee at Mindspace. The police registered a case and are investigating the circumstances surrounding her death. The incident occurred in an apartment in Chandra Nayak Thanda under the Madhapur police station limits in Hyderabad.

Article Title: FIR against Dharavi man for filing 24 SIR forms in a day to delete voter names
Article Text:
Giridhari Swaminath Jaiswal submitted an excessive number of applications for voter name deletions in Dharavi (Representative image)





MUMBAI: A case has been registered at the Dharavi police station against a local resident, Giridhari Swaminath Jaiswal, for filing 24 applications in a single day seeking deletion of names of individuals from the draft voter list of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in the state. The limit on the applications per day is 10.The application for the deletion is made through Form 7. However, the person making the application faces action if he provides incorrect information. Jaiswal also faces these charges."... It has been found that the prescribed rules have been violated. Accordingly, a complaint has been filed against Jaiswal for filing an application in Form 7 by giving false and incorrect information in violation of the rules," said a BMC press statement.When contacted, Maharashtra’s chief electoral officer S Chockalingam said, “Action is being taken as per the instructions of the ECI and our office.”The Opposition and civil rights groups have raised concerns about the use of Form 7 to delete the names of eligible voters.However, election authorities have said that action is taken against those who make applications based on incorrect information and also that the applications are scrutinised before being acted on.
Article Summary: Giridhari Swaminath Jaiswal submitted an excessive number of applications for voter name deletions in Dharavi. The limit on the applications per day is 10. Opposition and civil rights groups have raised concerns about the use of Form 7 to delete the names of eligible voters.

Article Title: Case against 3 from Pune for duping woman of Rs 50 lakh
Article Text:
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Police have booked three Pune-based businessmen for allegedly cheating a 43-year-old woman of Rs 50 lakh by promising her a partnership in a petrol pump and assuring her of monthly returns on her investment.The case was registered at Vedantnagar police station following a complaint by Shahana Ruhi Shakeel Sayyed, a resident of Rachnakar Colony.According to police, the three accused men operate a fuel station at Hadapsar, Pune.Deputy commissioner of police Pankaj Atulkar said, “The FIR is based on the documentary evidence submitted by the complainant along with her complaint.”Police said the trio allegedly convinced Sayyed to invest in the petrol pump business, claiming it was profitable and would generate regular returns.Trusting their assurances, Sayyed signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the accused on Feb 12, 2025. She later transferred Rs 50 lakh through two cheques of Rs 25 lakh each into the petrol pump’s account.According to the complaint, the accused paid returns for May and June 2025. However, they allegedly stopped making payments thereafter and failed to return her investment despite repeated demands.Claiming that she had been cheated, Sayyed approached the police with supporting documents, following which a case was registered.Police have launched an investigation into the alleged fraud. A sub-inspector-rank officer is conducting further probe.
Article Summary: The case was registered at Vedantnagar police station following a complaint by Shahana Ruhi Shakeel Sayyed, a resident of Rachnakar Colony. According to police, the three accused men operate a fuel station at Hadapsar, Pune. Police have launched an investigation into the alleged fraud.

Article Title: Aurangabad division graduates’ constituency: Concerns raised over oversized ballot papers
Article Text:
Voter apathy marks graduates’ constituency polls; oversized ballot papers raise concerns

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Voter apathy marked the Aurangabad division graduates’ constituency election on Friday, with turnout varying across Marathwada’s eight districts.Out of the 3,26,720 eligible voters across the eight Marathwada districts, 1,91,689 cast their votes, recording a turnout of 58.7%. Dharashiv recorded the highest turnout at 62.5%, with 18,225 of 29,145 voters participating.It was followed by Parbhani at 61.8%, where 16,482 of 26,684 voters cast their ballots, and Hingoli at 61.6%, with 6,352 of 10,315 voters turning out.Jalna and Nanded both recorded a turnout of 59.8%. In Jalna, 19,853 of 33,196 voters exercised their franchise, while in Nanded, 21,942 of 36,687 voters participated. Beed recorded 59.7%, with 34,416 of 57,672 voters casting their votes.Latur recorded a turnout of 56.5%, with 22,412 of 39,703 voters participating. Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, which had the highest number of registered voters at 93,318, recorded the lowest turnout at 55.7%, with 52,007 voters casting their ballots.The unusually large ballot papers, necessitated by the presence of 41 candidates, also raised concerns about the voting process. Maha Vikas Aghadi candidate Pratapsinh Patil questioned the rationale behind their size, alleging that the ballots were getting damaged while being inserted into boxes, which could lead to votes being disqualified.Voters at some polling stations struggled to unfold oversized ballot papers and mark candidates in order of preference, with staff helping them fold the papers. The process proved cumbersome even for graduates.Former MLC Satish Chavan, who has won the constituency three consecutive times, voted at Regional Agricultural Extension Management Institute in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. Patil, whose name gained prominence during the final phase of campaigning, cast his vote in Dharashiv.MVA candidate Patil demanded that none of the votes should be disqualified simply because the ballot paper got damaged. His views were seconded by BJP MLA Sudhir Mungantiwar.Despite visits by candidates and political leaders, including BJP district president Kishor Shitole, polling remained sluggish at several centres. Some candidates arranged four-wheelers to ferry voters in urban areas and auto rickshaws for those living within five kilometres of polling stations in taluka and semi-urban areas.
Article Summary: Out of the 3,26,720 eligible voters across the eight Marathwada districts, 1,91,689 cast their votes, recording a turnout of 58.7%. Dharashiv recorded the highest turnout at 62.5%, with 18,225 of 29,145 voters participating. Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar recorded the lowest turnout at 55.7%, with 52,007 voters casting their ballots.

Article Title: 2 booked for transferring Rs14.9 lakh from civil hospital account
Article Text:
File photo

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





An assistant superintendent of the district civil hospital at Chikalthana in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar and another person have been booked for allegedly transferring Rs 14.9 lakh from the hospital’s bank account using a cheque bearing a forged signature.The accused have been identified as Deepak Pundlikrao Jadhav, assistant superintendent at the hospital, and Vijay Ramesh Ujed. “The Cidco MIDC police registered the case following a complaint by Gururaj Govind Joshi, the hospital’s administrative officer and drawing and disbursing officer,” deputy commissioner of police (Zone II) Ratnakar Navale said.According to the complaint, a cheque issued against the hospital’s bank account was allegedly signed fraudulently on Oct 19, 2026, around 1.30 pm. The cheque was later issued in Ujed’s name, following which Rs 14,91,272 was credited to his bank account.The alleged irregularity came to light after the administrative officer raised a question over the unjustified transaction. The issue was brought to the notice of the higher-ups before reporting it to the police. The incident has raised concerns over the unauthorised transfer of govt hospital funds through the use of a cheque kept in the custody of an official.Police registered a case on Thursday night and began investigating how a cheque was prepared and processed to transfer money from a hospital’s account.Investigators are examining banking records, cheque-related documents and the transaction trail to determine how the money was transferred. The probe will establish the respective roles of the two accused, whether they acted together to facilitate the transfer and whether anyone else was involved in the alleged offence.“We are yet to establish the full circumstances surrounding the transaction. The allegations against the accused will be subject to investigation,” Navale said, adding that the possibility of involvement of other people cannot be ruled out.
Article Summary: The alleged irregularity came to light after the administrative officer raised a question over the unjustified transaction. The issue was brought to the notice of the higher-ups before reporting it to the police. The incident has raised concerns over the unauthorised transfer of govt hospital funds through the use of a cheque kept in the custody of an official.

Article Title: Rs 1 lakh bribe trap: Navi Mumbai ACB catches circle officer, talathi and woman assistant
Article Text:
The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite, Jaihind Birsha Koli (49) and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36).





NAVI MUMBAI: The Navi Mumbai Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has arrested two revenue officials and a woman assistant for allegedly accepting a Rs 1 lakh bribe from a villager in Chirner, Uran taluka, to register the names of his relatives in the 7/12 extract of a land record.The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite (52), circle officer at Koproli in Uran taluka; Jaihind Birsha Koli (49), talathi; and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36), an assistant to the revenue officials.Dharmaraj Sonake, deputy superintendent of police, Navi Mumbai ACB, said the complainant had applied to register the names of the heirs of his deceased sister in the 7/12 extract of their land in Chirner.The land was jointly owned by the complainant's maternal uncle, aunt, brother and sister. The complainant had also applied for deletion of his deceased brother's name and submitted the request to circle officer Mohite and talathi Koli. However, the two officials allegedly demanded Rs 1 lakh from him to process the work.Dy SP Sonake said, "After verification of the complaint on Monday, when it was confirmed that the revenue officers Mohite and Koli had told the complainant to hand over the bribe amount to the accused woman assistant Monika Patil, a trap was laid on Tuesday around 2 pm. After the woman assistant Monika Patil accepted the demanded bribe of Rs 1 lakh from the complainant and handed it over to circle officer Keshav Mohite, both were caught red-handed and arrested. While, the acccused Talathi Jaihind Koli who was involved in the bribe demand was taken into custody from Dronagiri."
Article Summary: The Navi Mumbai Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has arrested two revenue officials and a woman assistant for allegedly accepting a Rs 1 lakh bribe. The arrested accused were identified as Keshav Dagdu Mohite (52), circle officer at Koproli in Uran taluka; Jaihind Birsha Koli (49), talathi; and Monika Vijnesh Patil (36)

Article Title: Man in Mahindra Thar with duplicate plate molests woman, knocks down another in Kharghar
Article Text:
30-year-old man was apprehended for allegedly molesting a woman and injuring another in Navi Mumbai.





NAVI MUMBAI: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team within 10 hours on Thursday evening.He had allegedly molested a 26-year-old woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night and, an hour later, severely injured a 22-year-old woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, Kharghar.Acting on a complaint by the woman allegedly molested by the Thar SUV driver, Kharghar police registered an FIR under BNS section 74 for the offence of assault or criminal force against a woman with the intent to outrage her modesty.While, as per the complaint by the injured woman Shrawani Dandekar, a resident of sector 3, Belpada, an FIR under relevant BNS sections and Motor Vehicle Act was registered against the Thar SUV driver for rash and negligent driving causing hurt.The detained aaccused identified as Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of sector 50, Seawoods, Nerul was handed over to Kharghar police for further legal action.Previously, in January 2021, he was arrested by Nerul police in the FIR registered against him for alleged kidnapping, sexual harassment and molestation of a woman.Sanjay Joshi, senior inspector of Kharghar said, "The accused Nakhvi has been detained and subsequently it will be decided whether to arrest him or serve with a notice under Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) for cooperating in police investigating."Audumbar Patil, senior inspector of crime branch unit-3 said, "After an FIR for molestation was registered at Kharghar police station by the victim woman, a resident of sector 34, Kharghar. As per the orders of higher authority, our team started a parallel probe. From the CCTV camera surveillance near the crime scene, we obtained the red Thar SUV's registration number, which was of Vashi RTO passing.""When verified, the registration number was found to be that of a Maruti WagonR car. As the accused had used a duplicate registration number plate, we scrutinized as many as 62 Thar SUVs registered with various Regional Transport Offices (RTOs). Subsequently, we obtained the registration number of a red Thar SUV that was registered with Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar RTO," Patil added.SPI Patil further informed, "The SUV was registered in the name of Ali alias Talib Ahsan Nakhvi, a resident of Devaki Apartment in sector-50, Seawoods. From his mobile number registered with the RTO, his location was tracked.""He was apprehended from Bonkode village, Koparkhairane on Thursday late evening. Upon thorough interrogation, he confessed that he had inappropriately touched the woman pedestrian near Pethpada metro station while he drove his Thar SUV and sped away. He even confessed to have injured a woman pedestrian by hitting her his SUV while driving in Belpada area," he said.
Article Summary: A 30-year-old man wearing a mask and driving a red Thar SUV with a duplicate registration number plate was apprehended by the Crime Branch Unit-3 team on Thursday evening. He had allegedly molested a woman walking on the street in Kharghar, around 400metres from Pethpada metro station, on September 30 night. An hour later, he severely injured a woman by knocking her down in Belpada, Sector 3, KharGHar.

Article Title: 2 women escape from RPF lockup in Navi Mumbai; 1 held after 6 hours, cop suspended
Article Text:
The women removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping. (AI image)





NAVI MUMBAI: In a major security lapse at Belapur Railway Protection Force (RPF), two women arrested for allegedly attempting to steal overhead electric wires from the Juinagar railway godown escaped from the lockup after midnight on September 28.One of them was apprehended around six hours later, while the other remains at large.The woman constable on night duty has been suspended and a departmental inquiry has been initiated against her.As per the FIR registered by RPF sub-inspector Milap Parte (52) at Panvel GRP, a case was registered on September 24 under Section 3(a) of the Railway Property (Unauthorized Possession) Act, 1966, Amendment 2012, at Belapur railway police station.The case was based on a written memo submitted by RPF personnel Ravikant Gade regarding the theft of overhead electric wires from the godown at Juinagar railway station on September 21.During the probe, a trap was laid on September 26 and around 1pm, two women were found loitering suspiciously near the Juinagar godown with the alleged intention of committing theft.They were taken into custody and identified as Rupali Kailas Kurhade (30), from Jalna, and Shalibai Ashok Pawar (49), from Bhiwandi.They were arrested after an FIR was registered for attempted theft and produced before a CSMT court, which remanded them to police custody till September 30. They were lodged in the lockup at Belapur RPF police station.Day-shift woman constable Rakhi Malaiya was assigned guard duty at the lockup, after which woman head constable Pooja Bagre was on night duty.Around 2am on September 28, when Bagre had gone to the toilet, the two women allegedly managed to open the lock by inserting their hands through the iron bars of the lockup and jerking it. Police suspect the lock may not have been secured properly.The women then reached the balcony at the rear end of the police station. They removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping.The incident was captured on CCTV footage. PSI Parte learnt about the escape after waking up at home around 6.30am and finding several missed calls from head constable Bagre and ASI Rajiv Parsan.Sunil Nila, chief spokesperson of Central Railway, said, "One accused woman Rupali Kurhade was apprehended from near Nerul railway station around 8.45 am. The other accused Shalibai Pawar is still absconding."
Article Summary: The women removed their sarees, tied one end to the generator on the balcony and climbed down before escaping. One of them was apprehended around six hours later, while the other remains at large. The woman constable on night duty has been suspended and a departmental inquiry has been initiated.

Article Title: TMC suspends fire chief over immersion ghats lapses
Article Text:
Thane municipal corporation





THANE: The Thane municipal corporation (TMC) on Friday suspended its acting chief fire officer (CFO) over alleged negligence in providing adequate safety equipment at idol immersion ghats on Oct 20. Action has also been taken against two other officials, while show-cause notices have been served on two junior staff, it is learnt.The suspension order is issued by additional municipal commissioner-1, Prashant Rode, holds Jhalke responsible for lapses in carrying out his duties. The order states that he has been suspended under the Maharashtra Civil Services (Discipline and Appeal) Rules, 1979. Jhalke, who is the fire officer and in-charge of Balkum fire station, has been handling the additional charge of CFO for the last several years."Certain safety arrangements at Datta Mandir Ghat and Ahilyadevi Ghat at Masunda Lake were allegedly found to be inadequate, with a particular shortfall in life jackets and other essential safety equipment. The shortcomings were apparently pointed out to deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde who also expressed concern at the alleged negligence," said a civic official.Officials said that during the suspension period, Jhalke will be required to comply with the prescribed conditions and cannot take up other employment or engage in business without the requisite permission.
Article Summary: Thane municipal corporation suspends acting chief fire officer (CFO) over alleged negligence. Action also taken against two other officials, while show- cause notices have been served on two junior staff. Safety arrangements at Datta Mandir Ghat and Ahilyadevi Ghat at Masunda Lake allegedly found to be inadequate.

Article Title: Sealed Thane flat in Iqbal Kaskar-Dawood Ibrahim money laundering case breached; ED reclaims property, files FIR
Article Text:
Thane flat linked to Iqbal Kaskar’s extortion case targeted for occupation





MUMBAI: Enforcement Directorate (ED) filed an FIR for trespassing and attempting to occupy a flat in Thane which was attached in a money laundering case it investigated against Iqbal Kaskar and his Pakistan-based gangster brother Dawood Ibrahim The flat was attached in the case in 2022, in the money laundering case linked to extortion by Iqbal Kaskar and others.The flat was in ED’s possession and it had put its seal on the lock. Kaskar had acquired the flat through extortion and threat in 2015 and got it registered in the name of his associate Mumtaz Azaz Sheikh, alias Raju.Recently, the ED learnt that certain persons entered the flat after removing its possession notice, claiming ownership of the flat.Since the money laundering case is pending in the court, the ED informed the court about it, repossessed the flat and filed a police case last week.
Article Summary: Enforcement Directorate (ED) filed an FIR for trespassing and attempting to occupy a flat in Thane. The flat was attached in a money laundering case it investigated against Iqbal Kaskar and his Pakistan-based gangster brother Dawood Ibrahim. The ED repossessed the flat and filed a police case last week.

Article Title: Ulhasnagar social activist Haresh Gajwani shot dead outside railway station, 3 arrested
Article Text:
Haresh Gajwani was murdered outside Ulhasnagar railway station on Wednesday night.





ULHASNAGAR: Police have arrested three suspects in connection with the murder of social worker Haresh Gajwani, who was shot dead outside Ulhasnagar railway station on Wednesday night. The suspects have been identified as Avinash Naidu, Vijay Singh and Noor Alam Khan.According to preliminary investigations, Gajwani and Naidu had a long-standing dispute. In 2021, counter-cases were registered against the two sides following a dispute, which allegedly contributed to continuing tensions between Gajwani and the accused.Police said the three suspects were traced and detained with the help of CCTV footage. Investigators are examining the alleged past rivalry, along with other possible motives behind the murder.Gajwani, 54, was allegedly attacked by three assailants who fired two rounds at him before fleeing the scene. Locals and police took him to Central Hospital, where doctors declared him "brought dead".Recently, Gajwani had posted on X, tagging senior officials from various police departments, as well as the chief minister, deputy chief minister and FDA commissioner Tukaram Mundhe. In his posts, he had highlighted alleged illegal activities in the area and claimed that some police personnel were supporting those involved. He had also expressed fears for his life, warning that the police personnel he had accused would also be responsible if anything happened to him.
Article Summary: Haresh Gajwani, 54, was shot dead outside Ulhasnagar railway station on Wednesday. Police have arrested three suspects in connection with the murder. The suspects have been identified as Avinash Naidu, Vijay Singh and Noor Alam Khan. Investigators are examining the alleged past rivalry, along with other possible motives.

Article Title: Trio attacks constable at YCM Hospital, held
Article Text:
An AI-generated illustration shows three men wearing metal bracelets assaulting a police constable inside a hospital

Pune:





An on-duty police constable at YCM Hospital in Pimpri suffered cuts on his head and chest after three men allegedly attacked him around 4.30am on Saturday.The constable, Amol Shinde , is posted at the Pimpri Chinchwad police headquarters. He lodged a complaint against the three suspects with the Sant Tukaramnagar police.Later in the day, the police arrested the suspects, all residents of Pimple Gurav, for allegedly attempting to murder Shinde.According to the police, Shinde and another constable were on a night duty at the hospital. Article Title: Elderly woman knocked down by luxury car in Chennai; driver on run nabbed
Article Text:
Chennai:





In a hit-and-run case, a 62-year-old woman was fatally knocked down by a speeding car on ECR near Palavakkam on Friday night. Police arrested a restauranteur and seized his luxury vehicle that was involved in the accident.R Krishnaveni of Neelankarai was crossing the road to dump garbage around 10pm when the car hit her and sped away. Passersby called an ambulance to the spot, but the medical crew refused to take her to the hospital, claiming that she was already dead.Infuriated, Krishnaveni’s relatives and residents blocked the road. They said the police did not show up at the spot even an hour after the accident. A team from Adyar traffic investigation police station reached the spot and held talks with the protesters.Police said the ambulance crew did not alert them as per procedure, and another ambulance had to come from Royapettah govt hospital, which delayed shifting the deceased from the spot.Following inquiries, police identified the car and arrested its owner, Manikandan of Madambakkam.
Article Summary: R Krishnaveni of Neelankarai was crossing the road to dump garbage when the car hit her and sped away. Passersby called an ambulance to the spot, but the medical crew refused to take her to the hospital, claiming that she was already dead. Police identified the car and arrested its owner, Manikandan.

Article Title: ‘Ridiculed for eating beef’ at school, 16-year-old Tamil Nadu boy dies by suicide
Article Text:
The Class XI student’s parents at Peelamedu police station

Poll Vote & Share your view What is the most effective measure to prevent caste-based harassment in schools? Mandatory anti-bias training Strict legal penalties Independent oversight bodies Zero-tolerance policies 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion





COIMBATORE: A Class XI Scheduled Caste student of a govt-aided school died by suicide at his residence at Peelamedu in the city on Wednesday allegedly following harassment by his two classmates and a teacher over eating beef.The Peelamedu police have registered a case against class teacher Vijayakumar , headmaster Arun Kumar , and two students of Shri K K Naidu Higher Secondary School on Avinashi Road near Peelamedu in Coimbatore on charges of abetment of suicide and other offences.Police identified the deceased student as A Akilan, 16, son of Ashok Kumar and Kousalya Devi. Kumar works as a laundry manager at a resort in Munnar; Kousalya is a domestic help.Returning home from work around 1pm on Wednesday, Kousalya found her son hanging from the bedroom ceiling. She informed police, who shifted the body to ESI Govt Medical College Hospital for postmortem.In her complaint to police, Kousalya said a few months ago her son’s class teacher, while enrolling Scheduled Caste students for a scholarship scheme, asked who all in the class ate beef.Akilan and another student stood up. After that, two of his classmates started harassing Akilan by mentioning his caste; they also assaulted him, she said, accusing the teacher and headmaster of not taking action after Akilan complained to them.Police registered a case under sections 115(2), 108 of BNS and 3(2)(v) of The Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and began an investigation.Parents and relatives of Akilan protested in front of the police station on Wednesday evening demanding a proper investigation and the arrest of the teacher and the headmaster. Till Thursday night, the body was not handed over to the family as the postmortem was not conducted.“He (Akilan) wanted to become an advocate. The school management and the teacher are responsible for my son’s death. We need justice for him,” Kumar said.Deputy commissioner of police Thangadurai said an inquiry is underway at the police commissioner level. The Child Welfare Committee is also inquiring.
Article Summary: A Class XI Scheduled Caste student of a govt-aided school died by suicide at his residence at Peelamedu in the city on Wednesday. Police have registered a case against class teacher Vijayakumar, headmaster Arun Kumar and two students of Shri K K Naidu Higher Secondary School.

Article Title: 864 bottles of liquor seized from house near Erode; man arrested
Article Text: ERODE: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district in the early hours of Thursday and arrested a man.Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid at the house of K Govindaraj, 28, of Ammapalayam. Article Title: DMK responsible for removal of 97L voters: Vaiko
Article Text:
DMK responsible for removal of 97L voters: Vaiko





Madurai: MDMK chief Vaiko has blamed DMK for the deletion of 97 lakh voters from Tamil Nadu 's electoral rolls in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR).Speaking to reporters in Madurai on Saturday, Vaiko said booth-level processes across the state were dominated by DMK functionaries and the party should be held accountable for the deletions. “Some leaders claim SIR helped Vijay come to power. In my view, if not for the voter deletions, Vijay would have secured 30 more seats. DMK, not election commission, should answer for what happened in Tamil Nadu,” Vaiko said.He said chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar should resign or be removed from office for the nationwide controversy that SIR triggered."The fact that chief minister C Joseph Vijay is providing an honest administration is evident from the handling of the Sterlite issue. Till now, he has not permitted Sterlite owner Agarwal to meet him. While many in previous govts had yielded to the interests of the Sterlite plant, no such thing has happened under the present govt,” said Vaiko.He said allegations of law and order deterioration were politically motivated. Sexual offences and murders had occurred under every regime, he added.
Article Summary: MDMK chief Vaiko has blamed DMK for the deletion of 97 lakh voters from Tamil Nadu's electoral rolls. Vaiko said booth-level processes across the state were dominated by DMK functionaries and the party should be held accountable for the deletions.

Article Title: DMK, AIADMK and BJP will join hands to take on Vijay: Nirmal Kumar
Article Text:
DMK, AIADMK and BJP will join hands to take on Vijay: Nirmal Kumar





Madurai: Law minister C T R Nirmal Kumar on Saturday claimed that DMK AIADMK and BJP would join hands in the next election to take on chief minister C Joseph Vijay.Speaking to reporters after paying tribute to Maruthu Pandiyar brothers in Madurai on their 225th death anniversary, Nirmal Kumar said DMK and AIADMK were responsible for their own decline. “They decided to join hands to form a govt against the chief minister. In the next election, the AIADMK, DMK and BJP will come together against the chief minister. There is no doubt about that,” he said. He also claimed that DMK and AIADMK had entered into mutual concessions while contesting the bypolls to the Dharapuram and Madurantakam assembly constituencies.Responding to former AIADMK minister Sellur K Raju’s comment that the current dispensation was ‘temporary,’ Nirmal Kumar questioned Raju’s political standing. “First, Sellur Raju must decide whether he is with Edappadi K Palaniswami’s AIADMK or another faction. He and R B Udhayakumar should decide which AIADMK they belong to, whether they are moving towards T T V Dhinakaran or planning to make him the party’s general secretary,” he said. In a video statement, former AIADMK minister Udhayakumar had alleged that multiple power centres were operating within the TVK.Reacting to Nirmal Kumar’s criticism, former AIADMK minister Dindigul C Sreenivasan on Saturday accused him of being a “party hopper”. “How did AIADMK secure more than 45,000 votes in the bypoll constituencies?” he asked. Sreenivasan also alleged that the “drug culture” prevalent during the DMK regime was now spreading unchecked under the TVK govt and claimed that TVK functionaries were involved in several such cases.
Article Summary: DMK, AIADMK and BJP will join hands to take on Vijay: Nirmal Kumar. Law minister also questions Sellur K Raju’s political standing. Dindigul C Sreenivasan accused him of being a ‘party hopper’

Article Title: Youth hacks woman to death, abducts daughters
Article Text:
A 39-year-old woman was hacked to death and her husband and son injured in Thoothukudi district on Thursday night, allegedly after they opposed a man’s advances towards their teenage daughter.





Madurai: A youth hacked to death a 39-year-old woman, attacked her husband and son, before abducting her two teenage daughters near Sathankulam on Thursday night. Police rescued the girls within an hour and subsequently arrested the accused.Tuticorin superintendent of police R Shiva Prasad said the 23-year-old accused attacked the family after the couple asked their 15-year-old daughter with whom he was in a relationship to stop talking to him. Police identified the deceased as Mary Vijila, wife of Muthukrishnan, 43, of Mudalur.According to police, Gnana Prakash, 23, of Anandapuram was working as a parotta master, and had allegedly been in a relationship with Muthukrishnan’s 15-year-old daughter, a school dropout. On Thursday night, he arrived on a two-wheeler and attacked Muthukrishnan and Mary Vijila, as also their 12-year-old son using a sickle.Mary Vijila died on the spot of grievous injuries in her neck while Muthukrishnan sustained injuries on his shoulder, chin and hand. Their son sustained minor injuries on his finger and back. The accused then abducted the girl with whom he was in love as well as her 14-year-old sibling, a class VIII student, on his two-wheeler.On receiving information, police rushed to the spot, shifted the injured to hospital and sent Mary Vijila’s body to Tirunelveli Govt Medical College Hospital for postmortem. A case was registered by Thattarmadam police, and intensive search launched. Both the girls were rescued safely in an hour from the house of the accused, who was nabbed in another three hours, police said.
Article Summary: A 39-year-old woman was hacked to death and her husband and son injured in Thoothukudi district on Thursday night, allegedly after they opposed a man’s advances towards their teenage daughter. Police identified the deceased as Mary Vijila, wife of Muthukrishnan, 43, of Mudalur. According to police, Gnana Prakash, 23, of Anandapuram was working as a parotta master, and had allegedly been in a relationship.

Article Title: Tuition teacher arrested for sexually abusing 13-year-old girl
Article Text:
Tuition teacher arrested for sexually abusing 13-year-old girl

Dindigul

:





A 32-year-old assistant professor from a private college in Dindigul was arrested on Friday for allegedly sexually abusing a 13-year-old girl who was taking tuitions from him.The accused was identified as Saran . Police sources said the victim was studying in Class VIII.On Thursday evening, when the girl did not return home at the usual time, her parents became concerned and tried to contact her by phone. Article Title: Ernakulam Rural police to e-auction 310 vehicles
Article Text:
Kochi

:





The Ernakulam Rural district police have announced that as many as 310 vehicles kept at various police stations and office premises under its jurisdiction were being disposed of through an e-auction.The auction will be held on Nov 5, from 11am to 4.30pm. Most vehicles listed are two-wheelers, while auto-rickshaws, cars and trucks are also among the listed vehicles.Only around 40 vehicles are in running condition as the rest are listed as scrap. Those in running condition include a Yamaha FZ bike, a Royal Enfield Bullet, an Aprilia scooter and a Yamaha Fascino scooter among others. Most vehicles were seized by the police.Those interested in participating must register as buyers through the MSTC website, www.mstcecommerce.com.Prospective bidders can inspect the vehicles on working days between 10am and 5pm from Oct 24 to Nov 4, with the permission of the concerned officers.Details of the vehicles and their locations have been published in the auction notice on the Ernakulam Rural police website: https://ernakulamrural.keralapolice.gov.in/.

Article Title: Qatar KMCC burglary: IUML expels member
Article Text:
Kozhikode:





Amid investigation into a major burglary at Kerala Muslim Cultural Centre (KMCC) office in Qatar, Indian Union Muslim League (IUML) has expelled one of its members from the party. The robbery occurred in Sept 2025, in which cash worth approximately Rs 8 crore was stolen.The IUML state panel on Saturday announced the expulsion of Razak Kunnummel, through its mouthpiece, Chandrika Daily. Razak, also known as Rotana Razak of Thurayoor panchayat, has been expelled from the party and its associated organisations, including KMCC.A case was registered by Koyilandy Police on Sept 15, 2026, in connection with the theft of 31 lakh Qatari riyals from the KMCC office in Doha. The theft was reported on Sept 18, 2025, at the office in the Al Thumama area of Doha.According to the police, four people who allegedly travelled from Keralam to Qatar were involved in the theft. Parappil Balakrishnan, a native of Koyilandy and a regional BJP functionary, had surrendered before the police in connection with the case. He had levelled allegations against Razak.
Article Summary: Indian Union Muslim League (IUML) has expelled one of its members from the party. The robbery occurred in Sept 2025, in which cash worth approximately Rs 8 crore was stolen. The theft was reported on Sept 18, 2025, at the office in the Al Thumama area of Doha.

Article Title: Vlogger booked over communal remarks
Article Text:
Kochi

:





Fort Kochi police has registered an FIR against a vlogger for allegedly attempting to stoke communal enmity through an Instagram reel.According to the FIR, Amrith Singh Darren, after visiting Kashi Art Café, said the café, named after a city holy to Hindus, sold beef. Police said he also made hateful remarks about Muslims, claiming they dominated Fort Kochi. He further criticised an installation pairing portraits of Mahatma Gandhi and Muhammad Ali Jinnah.He challenged the state home minister and claimed locals had told him the state govt received funds from Arab nations to promote Islam.The FIR says he knew his actions could disrupt peace and harmony. He was booked under Sections 353(2) and 192 of BNS, covering circulation of false information with intent to promote enmity, hatred or ill will between religious groups, and provocation to cause a riot.Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan wrote on X that in Kerala there are places where cultures meet, histories intertwine and diversity thrives.“Now, a vlogger peddling hate for profit seeks to paint these vibrant destinations in communal colours. Having failed to divide Keralam, the Sangh Parivar is outsourcing its hate campaign to online provocateurs. But Keralam’s secular spirit will not yield to their politics of hatred. The state govt must take strict legal action against those spreading communal enmity,” he posted.
Article Summary: Amrith Singh Darren, after visiting Kashi Art Café, said the café, named after a city holy to Hindus, sold beef. He also made hateful remarks about Muslims, claiming they dominated Fort Kochi. He challenged the state home minister and claimed locals had told him the state govt received funds from Arab nations to promote Islam.
